intentionalVisualContract.spectrum: Deterministic spherical synthesis uses shared 4.2, 9.1 and 18.5 frequency multipliers; regional detail additionally admits 36.5 and 144. Elevation and source local relief continuously gate the mountain terms, while every tile in one detail mode samples the same profile so mixed-LOD edges do not select different bands. These are visual frequencies, not additional measured landform resolution.
intentionalVisualContract.coordinateIdentity: The procedural color and shading-normal signal uses each PALEOMAP fragment reference direction, so a tracked material does not switch synthetic bump or roughness patterns when its native endpoint texture coordinates change.
intentionalVisualContract.physicalHeight: PALEOMAP signed-metre positions and displayed-height draping remain unchanged; a 13,068-byte one-tile scratch position array exists only while deriving normals and is released before temporal staging.
intentionalVisualContract.roughness: PALEOMAP temporal materials use explicit scalar render conventions 0.82 for surface and 0.91 for seafloor. No measured palaeoroughness field is claimed and no source-independent roughness map is bound.
intentionalVisualContract.seams: Coincident staged edge normals are averaged by canonical direction and 2:1 stitched edges use normalized even-vertex interpolation before atomic publication.
intentionalVisualContract.settledLod: Live PALEOMAP temporal preview is bounded to 6 root tiles; after refinement settles, high quality returns to the projected 96-leaf, level-4-capable policy. The measured 100 Ma view selected 96 leaves across levels 1 to 3. Cao remains separately capped at 18 level-1 leaves.
intentionalVisualContract.detailProfile: The temporal material job latches one SurfaceDetail for every tile. Orbital/coarse uses the restrained profile; regional uses the source-ruggedness-gated mountain profile. A focused regression proves the profile changes temporary shading positions while the sourced physical positions remain byte-identical.
intentionalVisualContract.exactModern: At exact 0 Ma, the final settled cube publishes its already generated native fields atomically: current-exaggeration physical positions, source-local normals, stitched native UVs, climate-qualified albedo, and patch-only feathered ETOPO residual bump. It performs no endpoint resolver/material solve, installs the actual visible-triangle sampler, and reports the distinct reused vertex count. This exact-native path does not apply above 0 Ma.
intentionalVisualContract.overlayPublication: Installing any new displayed-height sampler marks overlay drape updating and schedules a key-checked rebuild. The prior overlay remains visible until replacement; ready is emitted only with the current sampler key applied.
intentionalVisualContract.modernRefinement: The adaptive cube is the sole visible and displayed-height-sampled terrain. The legacy regional overlay worker is inactive; source elevation, gradients and denser material texels live only in intersecting cube tiles under the existing 160-entry/48 MiB LRU. Dual-mode ETOPO negative depth colors and shades blue surface water while physical surface geometry remains at zero; exposed seafloor retains signed physical height. A post-pole surface clamp preserves this water-shell contract after raster pole completion.
intentionalVisualContract.presentation: The bounded daylight convention uses a warm directional key at intensity 3.2, neutral hemisphere fill at 0.8, cool fill at 0.22, exposure 1.02 and a reduced stage vignette. At close aerial zoom, country ribbon half-width tapers continuously to 900 m; POI glows remain projection-bounded at 9 px (12 px selected). These are rendering conventions rather than data claims.
intentionalVisualContract.focusTransition: Automatic 950 ms landscape flights retain the prior coherent terrain without generating successive intermediate 96-leaf plans; their existing completion callback requests one final view. Direct drag or wheel input cancels the flight and the normal debounced controls-end refresh resumes refinement.

caledonianSourceCheck.method: Present western-Norway material anchor reconstructed at each native PALEOMAP age, equal camera distance 1.8200 to 1.8201 and 18x display exaggeration.
caledonianSourceCheck.interpretation: The source captures high Caledonian-belt relief at 420 Ma and much lower modern elevation at the same present anchor. The modern height cannot be attributed directly to Caledonian relief because later uplift, exhumation and glacial incision contribute. Persistent high values at 390 and 355 Ma mean this PaleoDEM sequence does not independently resolve or validate post-orogenic extensional collapse; extension and exhumation also need not imply monotonic corridor lowering.

final420Capture.artifactRelationship: Captured on bec45bb8 before exact-0-only source preservation and sampler-key overlay scheduling. The 420 Ma terrain/material/LOD path is unchanged in final 6319b833.

limitations: The final material is structured visual synthesis over the 1 degree runtime DEM, not additional measured topography and not a claim of photographic realism.

The restored high-quality PALEOMAP view uses 96 projected leaves (levels 1 to 3 in the measured scene), preserving the prior settled geometry policy. It still cannot remove 1 degree source-grid coastline steps or broad diagonal relief forms, and the added stable-material publication increases initial readiness by roughly 0.43 to 0.46 seconds versus the 605392 control.

The equal-view Caledonian sequence shows a broad authored high, not the branching continental-scale mountain hierarchy in an illustrative reconstruction; the source does not independently resolve Devonian extensional collapse.
Optional Cao converted coast geometry and unsupported material remain visibly coarse/partial; this check does not reclassify those data gaps.

Registered ETOPO relief patches and source-qualified modern climate material are valid only at exact 0 Ma. The 0–5 Ma open interval intentionally returns to PALEOMAP registered relief and synthesized material rather than inventing motion for modern-only controls, so a local height/material transition can remain immediately above 0 Ma.

The final exact-modern app views improve source-driven relief and stable material structure but remain generalized and faceted relative to the supplied Apple Maps references. The final user-facing set uses the actual 8x default; 18x captures remain stress/inspection views, and no satellite-equivalence claim follows.

The established material/Cao CPU scopes pass, but the separately reported conservative sum of source roots, sequential refinement, preparation and publication is 512.7-528.7 ms for final PAL/Cao controls, above the 500 ms target. The pass is therefore not performance-complete under that expanded accounting.
